name: lexis-ai
description: Live-table GM assistant for tabletop RPGs: records reported events as canon, lists their ripples as hypotheses, and updates world files only after end-of-session approval. Game systems: 5E SRD, ORC 2E Core, Fate Accelerated, Fate Core, d100 Percentile Core, Forged in the Dark Core and Doom d20 Core.

interface.shortDescription: Live-table GM assistant for tabletop RPGs
interface.longDescription: Records the events you report at the table as canon, lists their ripples through the world as hypotheses, creates scene tags and obstacles in your game system, and updates your world files only with your approval at the end of the session. Plain Markdown + [[wiki-links]].
defaultPrompt: Set up a new campaign world
Record what just happened at the table and list its ripples
Close the session and show the changes for approval
